headline: September-quarter profit up 52%
summary: Revenue rose 41.9% to ₹458.9 crore and profit 51.8% to ₹80.8 crore from a year earlier.

headline: Profit nearly triples on record copper prices
summary: September-quarter revenue rose 63.7% from a year earlier and profit about 182%, as copper set repeated record highs during the quarter.

headline: Profit slips despite higher sales
summary: Revenue rose 5.1% to ₹26.8 crore but profit fell 3.6% to ₹6.4 crore, so margins narrowed; revenue was also lower than the previous quarter.

headline: Revenue up 12.5%; ITC Infotech combination on track
summary: Quarterly revenue reached ₹645 crore and the company kept its 12.5% growth guidance for the year. It says the planned combination with ITC Infotech is progressing as planned.

headline: Revenue and profit roughly double
summary: September-quarter revenue rose 110% to ₹319 crore and profit 100% to ₹36 crore from a year earlier.

headline: Revenue up 30%, profit up 7.5%
summary: Revenue grew 29.9% to ₹402 crore with a 40% operating margin, but profit grew more slowly as costs rose.

headline: AI systems drive a fourfold jump in revenue
summary: Revenue rose 336% to ₹1,323 crore and profit 335% to ₹137 crore; AI systems were 58% of revenue. The order book stood at ₹2,629 crore and the company raised ₹1,200 crore.

headline: RBI raises repo rate to 5.50%
summary: The RBI raised rates by 0.25 percentage points and changed its stance to 'calibrated tightening'. Rising rates tend to weigh on bond fund prices and on richly valued stocks.

headline: ₹7,000 crore plan to expand mining
summary: The company plans to invest ₹7,000 crore over five to six years, signed agreements with several public-sector firms, and partnered with Chile's CODELCO.

headline: Silver down 46% from its peak
summary: After a huge 2025 rally, silver fell from ₹4.39 lakh per kg to about ₹2.38 lakh by late April on a strong dollar and profit-taking. Analysts cited long-term industrial demand but expected short-term pressure from interest rates.
